description:
Initial public release of **MaterialTidal** targeting **TIDAL `v2.220.1`** (`com.aspiro.tidal`) on **Android 12L+ (API 32+)**.

### Highlights & Included Patches
- **Material You dynamic theme:** Remaps Wave 1, Wave 2, Square Market, and `MainActivity` surfaces/accents to Android 12+ Monet tonal tokens (`expressive`, `vibrant`, `subtle`, optional AMOLED pure black) and adds a shared API 31+ GPU frosted-glass blur kit (`ExpressiveBlurKit`).
- **System Light & Dark theme:** Adds a Material 3 Expressive Monet Light (White) Mode and switches TIDAL dynamically between Light and Dark themes based on the Android system setting (or forced mode).
- **Material 3 Expressive navbar & mini-player:** Split-pill floating dock (`64dp`) with detached circular Search button, progressive backdrop blur, spring physics, and a separate floating mini-player card with swipe-to-skip and pull-up-to-open gestures.
- **Material 3 Expressive full player:** Blurred album-art backdrop, cover-adaptive + Monet palettes, connected split pills, animated wavy seekbar, morphing transport controls, full-screen animated lyrics, and expressive Play Queue.
- **Expressive Material 3 homepage:** Expressive shortcut cards, rounded carousel artwork, Monet Vibe chips & AppBar, unlocked pull-to-refresh, and promo/merch/banner decluttering options.
- **Expressive Material 3 playlist screen:** Full-bleed downward-fading & progressively blurred hero cover, cover-adaptive + Monet palette, `52dp` pill Play/Shuffle buttons, connected action tiles, frosted collapsing toolbar, and polished `68dp` track rows.
- **Expressive Material 3 albums, artists & my tracks:** Extends the Material 3 Expressive design system to Album pages, Artist pages, My Tracks, My Albums, and My Artists.
- **Expressive Material 3 search:** Stadium-pill/squircle Monet search bars, frosted sticky glass headers, animated filter chips, suggestion/history badges, and Monet-harmonized genre/explore cards.
- **Expressive Material 3 bottom sheets & menus:** Unified XML & Compose Material 3 bottom sheets, grouped context menu cards, circular tonal icon badges, pill drag handles, frosted popup/overflow menus, and expressive dialogs.
- **Track swipe gestures:** Spring-back swipe gestures across all TIDAL track list binders (`Add to Queue`, `Play Next`, `Toggle Favorite`, `Add to Playlist`, configurable threshold and haptics).
- **Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback *(optional, off by default)*:** Local Wi-Fi OpenHome SSDP discovery inside TIDAL's Devices sheet and Lossless / 24-bit/192 kHz Hi-Res FLAC playback with lossless DASH-FLAC remuxing, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 albums, artists & my tracks
patches.description: Extends the Material 3 Expressive design (fading hero covers, cover-adaptive & Monet palettes, 52dp pill buttons, connected secondary tiles, scroll-morphing toolbars, and clean collection headers) to Albums, Artists, My Tracks, My Albums, and My Artists.

options.description: Apply the downward-fading hero cover, adaptive Monet colors, pill controls, and connected action bar to Album pages and My Albums.
Apply the downward-fading artist portrait hero, adaptive Monet colors, contributor chips, pill controls, and connected action bar to Artist pages and My Artists.
Apply Monet pill Play/Shuffle buttons, a tonal rounded Offline Download card, and clean track rows to My Tracks.
Redesigns the Collection screen category list into a Material 3 Expressive Bento tile grid with spring press animations and circular tonal top-bar buttons.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 bottom sheets & menus
patches.description: Redesigns all TIDAL bottom sheets, track/media context menus, toolbar overflow & dropdown menus, and dialogs across XML Views and Jetpack Compose Material 3 with expressive corners, grouped menu cards, tonal icon badges, pill drag handles, and Monet surfaces.

options.description: Controls corner curvature for Material bottom sheets, popup/dropdown menus, and alert dialogs.
Style track, album, playlist, and settings bottom-sheet menu items as M3 Expressive grouped tonal cards with circular icon badges.
Apply 22dp rounded floating Monet containers, clean spacing, and pill ripples to AppCompat popup menus and Compose DropdownMenus.
Upgrade AlertDialogs and Compose AlertDialogs with 28dp Monet containers, crisp borders, and pill action buttons.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 homepage
patches.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Homepage with Material 3 Expressive shortcut cards, rounded carousel artwork, Monet-styled Vibe chips and AppBar, unlocked pull-to-refresh, and promo decluttering.

options.description: Corner radius style for album/playlist carousel cards and quick-access shortcut cards.
Enables TIDAL's native Material pull-to-refresh gesture on the Homepage feed.
Hides the top creator upload promotional banner on the Homepage.
Hides promotional banners injected between Homepage music carousels.
Hides merchandising shopping carousels from the Homepage.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 playlist screen
patches.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Playlist screen in Material 3 Expressive style with a full-bleed downward-fading cover, cover-adaptive + Monet colors, pill Play/Shuffle buttons, connected action tiles, scroll-morphing toolbar, and polished track rows.

options.description: Use colors extracted dynamically from each playlist cover or strictly follow your system Monet wallpaper.
Display playlist artwork edge-to-edge at the top with a smooth downward fade into the surface canvas.
Round track artwork corners (12dp), add pill ripples, and preserve TIDAL's default active-track highlight.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 search
patches.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Search & Explore landing page, default UnifiedSearchView, and refactored Compose Search screen with stadium-pill Monet search bars, frosted sticky glass headers, expressive filter pills, suggestion badges, and Monet-harmonized genre/tag cards.

options.description: Controls the corner style for the Search bar across Search Landing, Active Search, and Compose Search.
Style Browse/Explore genre tiles, cloud pill tags, and navigation rows as tonal Material 3 Expressive cards.
Float scrolling Explore and Search results beneath a frosted GPU-blurred header backdrop (API 31+).

patches.name: Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback
patches.description: Discovers Linn DS/DSM speakers (OpenHome) on the local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless / Hi-Res FLAC playback with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.

options.description: Audio quality streamed to Linn Majik DSM over Wi-Fi (Hi-Res remuxes 24-bit/192 kHz DASH FLAC losslessly into native FLAC).
Local HTTP Proxy guarantees compatibility across all Linn DSM/1-5 generations and enables bit-perfect 24-bit/192 kHz DASH FLAC remuxing.
Automatically wakes the Linn Majik DSM from standby and switches its active source to Playlist when selected in TIDAL.
Optional LAN IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:55178) if SSDP multicast discovery is blocked on your Wi-Fi network.

patches.name: Material 3 Expressive full player
patches.description: Replaces TIDAL's Now Playing screen with a Material 3 Expressive player featuring a heavily blurred cover backdrop, connected split pills, squiggly animated seekbar, morphing transport shapes, full-screen animated lyrics, and an expressive Play Queue.

options.description: How the heavily blurred cover backdrop and tonal accents are rendered.
Swipe the album artwork horizontally with spring tilt physics to skip to next or previous track.
Animate the active playback track with a Material 3 Expressive sine wave while playing.
Redesigns the Play Queue and Suggested Tracks modal with cover-adaptive tonal scrims, segmented pill tabs, spotlight active card, and expressive track cards.

patches.name: Material 3 Expressive navbar & mini-player
patches.description: Replaces TIDAL's bottom bar and mini-player with a Material 3 Expressive split-pill floating navbar (with detached search button) and a separate floating mini-player card.

options.description: Material You surface palette style for the floating navbar and mini-player.
Shows Home, Explore, and Library in the left pill and Search in the right circle (hiding the Uploads tab).
Swipe the floating mini-player left/right to skip or go back with morphing preview pills, and pull up to interactively expand the full-screen player.
Replaces the solid bottom color fade behind the floating navigation bar and mini-player with a live multi-tier GPU progressive blur and frosted glass pills.

patches.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches.description: Remaps TIDAL's hardcoded cyan accents, Market colors, dark zinc surfaces, and corner shapes across Wave 1, Wave 2, and Square Market to Android Material 3 Expressive Monet tokens.

options.description: Keep pure #000000 background instead of tonal Material You base surface while still dynamically tinting accents and elevated cards.
Controls how strongly wallpaper Monet chroma tints app surfaces and cards.
Upgrades Square Market and Wave 1/Wave 2 corner radii to rounder Material 3 Expressive squircle/pill geometry.
Enables hardware-accelerated RenderEffect & cross-window blur across hero artwork fading, sticky toolbars, bottom sheets, popup menus, and dialogs (API 31+).
Controls the blur radius multiplier applied to progressive blur fades and frosted glass surfaces.

patches.name: System Light & Dark theme
patches.description: Adds a Material 3 Expressive Monet Light (White) Mode and switches TIDAL automatically between Light and Dark themes based on your Android system setting (or forces Light/Dark), adapting all Compose surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.

options.description: Automatically switch TIDAL between Material You Light (White) and Dark Mode following Android system settings, or lock to Light or Dark.

patches.name: Track swipe gestures
patches.description: Adds Material 3 Expressive swipe gestures to track rows (queue, play next, favorite, add to playlist).

options.description: Action triggered when swiping a track row to the right.
Action triggered when swiping a track row to the left.
Vibrate subtly when crossing the swipe threshold and triggering an action.
Horizontal drag distance in dp required to trigger a swipe action (36–160).
